messages:
incident-bot: [AUTOPAGE] PagerDuty alert fired for service=metrics-ingest, check=log_ingest_queue_backlog. Condition: backlog_ratio > 0.9 for 20s. PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4521 — Escalation: metrics-ingest-oncall
PagerDuty: Incident PD-4521 created and auto-assigned to metrics-ingest-oncall. Priority: P2. Links: logs / metrics / runbook.
Jess: acked in PD — grabbing logs now. I see the page, starting tail on ingest-worker-4 logs. Any initial thoughts?
Alex: seeing huge consumer lag on group `log-ingest-workers` — ~120k offsets behind on topic `ingest-raw-events`. ingest-worker-4 CPU ~98% and OOMs in last 10m.
Sam: support pinged — two customers reported delayed real-time dashboards (ticket #7894). Not a full outage but visible latency.
Ria: jumping in — likely producer burst + sink slowdown. Quick plan: scale consumers, restart offending pod, throttle noisy producers, increase s3 sink parallelism.
Jess: running: ```kubectl -n ingest scale deploy/log-ingest-workers --replicas=10```
Jess: also: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/log-ingest-workers -n ingest``` — will watch rollout.
incident-bot: Deployment scale noted (user=Jess). Watch: https://k8s-console.local/namespace/ingest/deploy/log-ingest-workers
Alex: running kafka checks: ```kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group log-ingest-workers``` shows partitions stalled, lag concentrated on partitions 2/5/7.
Ria: temporarily rate-limiting debug/noisy topics: applied broker-side throttle for topics matching `metrics.debug.*`. Command: `kafka-configs --alter --entity-type topics --entity-name metrics.debug.* --add-config retention.ms=60000` (temporary).
Jess: restart succeeded on worker-4, current replicas healthy 10/10.
Alex: good signal — consumer lag dropping from 120k -> 28k in ~4m. Throughput back to ~1800 msgs/s (was 400 msgs/s during spike).
Sam: updating support: "we've mitigated backlog, ingestion is processing; dashboards should catch up in ~20-40m. We'll follow up when fully cleared."
Ria: also increased sink parallelism on s3-sink: ```kubectl set env deploy/s3-sink WORKER_PARALLELISM=8 -n ingest``` — this speeds up S3 writes, should help tail drain.
PagerDuty: PD-4521 reassigned to Alex for remediation/cleanup and RCA. Escalation timer reset.
Jess: adding quick runbook note in incident doc: restarted worker-4, scaled consumers to 10, applied producer throttles for `metrics.debug.*`, increased s3 sink parallelism. Current backlog ~26.5k and decreasing.
Oncall SRE: acked in Slack / PD — taking handoff for the night. Please leave any follow-up notes.
Alex: leaving handoff checklist: monitor consumer lag, confirm no OOMs on workers, verify S3 error-rate < 1%. If lag stops decreasing for 10m, revert rate-limit and investigate partition hotspoting.
Jess: :thumbsup: thanks all. I'll post a short postmortem once we have complete logs (ETA 24h).
incident-bot: PD-4521 status updated: acknowledged by Jess, reassigned to Alex, oncall handoff to Oncall SRE.
Sam: filed customer update in ticket #7894 and Slack #support-updates.
Ria: leaving one more note — added temporary alert to watch s3-sink write latency (threshold 5s) until backlog is cleared.
Oncall SRE: will keep watch and will escalate to infra if S3 latency spikes. Good handoff.
